BREAKING: NDC Condemns Vicious Attack on Supporters in Benin, Edo State

The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) strongly condemns the vicious and unprovoked attack on our supporters in Benin City, Edo State, today, 25 November 2026.

As our presidential candidate, His Excellency Peter Obi, arrived in the state for a town hall meeting and campaign activities, suspected political thugs reportedly attacked NDC members and supporters along Airport Road. 

Reports indicate that the assailants opened fire, damaged campaign vehicles and buses, and left several people injured. Videos circulating online show the aftermath of this brazen assault.

This latest incident follows a disturbing pattern of violence, intimidation, and attacks against NDC members, candidates, and structures across Edo State and other parts of the country. Politics is not war. No Nigerian should be attacked, shot at, or terrorised simply for supporting a political party or exercising their democratic rights.

We call on the Edo State Police Command, the Inspector-General of Police, and all relevant security agencies to:

- Immediately secure the area and protect NDC supporters, candidates, and our presidential candidate during his stay in Edo State.

- Conduct a swift, transparent, and impartial investigation into the attack.

- Identify, arrest, and prosecute all those responsible, including any sponsors or enablers, regardless of political affiliation.

- Guarantee the safety of all political actors and ensure that campaigns and lawful political activities can take place without fear of violence.

The NDC remains committed to peaceful, issue-based politics. We will not be intimidated or driven out of any part of Nigeria. Our supporters are law-abiding citizens, and their safety is non-negotiable.

We urge all Nigerians, civil society, the media, and the international community to take note of this escalating political violence and to hold the authorities accountable for protecting every citizen’s right to political participation.

Notes: The attached videos are very graphic. Viewer discretion is advised.
